recommendations.title: Collect corroborating evidence: sensitive_file
recommendations.reason: HTTP status and response size alone do not establish whether the target file was returned, read or executed.
where_to_check: Historical response bodies, application file-read records and host file-access audit logs
Web server/proxy routing configuration and historical generic error-page responses
recommendations.method: Correlate the recorded interval, host, URI and request identifiers; source IP alone is not verified identity.
recommendations.success_evidence: Records showing that the response contained nonpublic file contents, or that an unauthorized file read or execution occurred.
recommendations.failure_evidence: Records showing rejection before file access, or processing that returned no sensitive information without reading the target file.

recommendations.title: Review applicable preventive controls
where_to_check: The referenced route, component configuration and authorized traffic baseline
recommendations.method: Verify whether the referenced paths are intended to be public before reviewing exposure and file access controls.

recommendations.title: Collect corroborating evidence: sqli
recommendations.reason: Access logs do not record the backend queries executed or the data retrieved or changed.
where_to_check: Application processing/error logs and historical responses
Audit logs for the relevant database, directory service or XML query processing
recommendations.method: Correlate the recorded interval, host, URI and request identifiers; source IP alone is not verified identity.
recommendations.success_evidence: Records showing that input in the request caused an unintended query and data retrieval, modification or authentication bypass.
recommendations.failure_evidence: Records showing rejection before query execution, or processing in which the input was treated as a value and caused no unintended query or result.

recommendations.title: Review applicable preventive controls
where_to_check: The referenced route, component configuration and authorized traffic baseline
recommendations.method: Confirm whether the affected input reaches a database or interpreter before reviewing parameterization and validation.

recommendations.title: Collect corroborating evidence: xss
recommendations.reason: Access logs alone do not show how input was embedded in responses or stored data, or whether it executed in a browser.
where_to_check: Historical response HTML, stored data and records of the pages displaying it
Execution/network records from the relevant browser and CSP reports
recommendations.method: Correlate the recorded interval, host, URI and request identifiers; source IP alone is not verified identity.
recommendations.success_evidence: Records showing that a script derived from the input executed on the target page. Reflection or storage alone does not confirm execution.
recommendations.failure_evidence: Records showing input rejection, or escaping that prevented execution at the relevant output location. CSP blocking records apply to the specific execution attempt.

recommendations.title: Review applicable preventive controls
where_to_check: The referenced route, component configuration and authorized traffic baseline
recommendations.method: Confirm the affected rendering context before reviewing output encoding and content handling.

recommendations.success_evidence: Corroborating application, host or response evidence is required to confirm success.
recommendations.failure_evidence: Contemporaneous records showing rejection before the affected operation can support failure for the verified requests.
